# Norton Equipment Co.

> Norton Equipment Co. sells, services, and rebuilds commercial trash compactors, balers, and recycling equipment for businesses within roughly 100 miles of Memphis (West Tennessee, North Mississippi, East Arkansas). Independent since 1997, based at 60 Amy Ln, Byhalia, MS 38611. Phone (662) 838-7900. Any brand, any model; own service technicians and an in-house fabrication shop.

## Business details
- Shop: 60 Amy Ln, Byhalia, MS 38611.
- Phone: (662) 838-7900. Hours: Mon-Thu 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM · Fri 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM.
- Coverage: Serving the Mid-South within roughly 100 miles of Byhalia and Memphis: West Tennessee, North Mississippi, and East Arkansas. Confirm availability and scheduling for the specific site.
- Equipment options: new, used, and refurbished. Used balers are sold as-is; refurbished balers carry a shop warranty with written terms.
- Service: repairs, preventive maintenance, evaluations, refurbishment, logistics, and rigging. Emergency response depends on urgency and technician availability.
- Quotes: equipment pricing depends on specification, condition, site preparation, delivery, and installation.

## Trash Compactors
- [Commercial Trash Compactors](https://nortonequipmentco.com/trash-compactors/): Commercial trash compactor sales, installation, and service across Memphis, North Mississippi, West Tennessee, and East Arkansas. Self-contained, stationary, vertical, pre-crusher, and auger compactors: every major brand, since 1997.
- [Self-Contained Compactors](https://nortonequipmentco.com/trash-compactors/self-contained/): Leak-tight compaction for wet waste: grocery, food service, hospitals.
- [Stationary Compactors](https://nortonequipmentco.com/trash-compactors/stationary/): High-volume dry-waste compaction for warehouses, DCs, retail, and manufacturing.
- [Vertical & Apartment Compactors](https://nortonequipmentco.com/trash-compactors/vertical-apartment/): Compact machines for behind stores and at the end of apartment trash chutes.
- [Pre-Crusher Compactors](https://nortonequipmentco.com/trash-compactors/pre-crusher/): Crushes pallets, drums, crates, and furniture before compaction.
- [Auger Compactors](https://nortonequipmentco.com/trash-compactors/auger/): Screw-driven compaction for high-volume cardboard and wood waste.
- [Front-Load & Rear-Load Containers](https://nortonequipmentco.com/trash-compactors/front-load-rear-load/): Standard hauler-compatible containers for regular pickup routes.
- [Steel Options](https://nortonequipmentco.com/trash-compactors/steel-options/): Walk-on decks, drive-on decks, chutes, enclosures, and guards, built custom for your site.
- [Used Compactors](https://nortonequipmentco.com/trash-compactors/used/): Shop-reconditioned compactors, built to order on a short turnaround.

## Balers & Recycling
- [Balers & Recycling Equipment](https://nortonequipmentco.com/balers-recycling/): Vertical, horizontal, two-ram, and specialty balers, plus refurbished machines and wire delivery across the Mid-South since 1997.
- [Vertical Balers](https://nortonequipmentco.com/balers-recycling/vertical-balers/): The standard downstroke baler for retail, grocery, and warehouse back rooms.
- [Horizontal Balers](https://nortonequipmentco.com/balers-recycling/horizontal-balers/): Automatic high-volume baling for DCs, recyclers, and manufacturers, built to the job.
- [Two-Ram Balers](https://nortonequipmentco.com/balers-recycling/two-ram-balers/): Automatic two-ram balers for recyclers and high-volume, multi-material plants.
- [Specialty Balers](https://nortonequipmentco.com/balers-recycling/specialty-balers/): Balers for foam, film, and other specialty materials, sourced to your spec.
- [Refurbished Balers](https://nortonequipmentco.com/balers-recycling/refurbished-balers/): Balers stripped and rebuilt in our Byhalia shop, at roughly half the cost of new.
- [Used Balers](https://nortonequipmentco.com/balers-recycling/used-balers/): Machines sold as they came in: inspected, honestly described, priced accordingly.
- [Baling Wire](https://nortonequipmentco.com/balers-recycling/baling-wire/): Single-loop and double-loop bale ties, boxed wire, delivered regionally.

## Services
- [Equipment Service & Repair](https://nortonequipmentco.com/services/): Factory-quality service for compactors, balers, and recycling equipment: any brand, any model. Repair, preventive maintenance, refurbishment, and equipment logistics across the Mid-South since 1997.
- [Compactor Repair & Service](https://nortonequipmentco.com/services/compactor-repair/): Repair and emergency service for every compactor make and model.
- [Baler Service & Repair](https://nortonequipmentco.com/services/baler-service/): Repair, parts, and service for vertical and horizontal balers.
- [Preventive Maintenance](https://nortonequipmentco.com/services/preventive-maintenance/): Scheduled PM programs that prevent the expensive phone call.
- [Equipment Evaluations & Inspections](https://nortonequipmentco.com/services/equipment-evaluations/): Independent condition assessments for purchases, audits, and budgets.
- [Equipment Refurbishment](https://nortonequipmentco.com/services/equipment-refurbishment/): Full rebuilds that give tired machines a second decade.
- [Equipment Logistics](https://nortonequipmentco.com/services/equipment-logistics/): Waste and recycling equipment delivered, installed, and commissioned.
- [Rigging & Machinery Moving](https://nortonequipmentco.com/services/rigging/): Heavy machinery moved, set, and torn out. It does not have to be recycling equipment.
- [Waste Stream Consultations](https://nortonequipmentco.com/services/waste-stream-consultations/): A free on-site audit that finds the money hiding in your waste.
